'''Kerse's squad''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of elite [[Imperial Special Forces (Sith Empire)|special forces]] [[Imperial soldier|Sith troopers]] in service of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. They participated at the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]]. These soldiers were in service of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] and were commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kerse]].
